messages:
maria: quick follow-up on the observability pipeline RFC — specifically around per-request cost attribution and where to do enrichment. i sketched a hybrid approach, want feedback before i turn it into a PR.

sam: SGTM in general. curious about cardinality explosion if we push all billing tags at ingress. any thoughts on limiting unique values? :thinking:

maria: yep — main idea is to compute coarse cost tags at ingress (model_id, model_variant, quant, route, region, billing_tier) and emit those with traces/metrics. then do a separate offline pass that maps runtime signals (token_count, kv_cache_hits) to a refined cost model by model_version/time-window. so online source has low-cardinality keys, offline enriches per-aggregate.

liam: that makes sense. we should also decide sampling policy for traces vs metrics. full metrics for every request, sample traces 1-5% by default, but force-full for errors and large token counts.

nisha: watch out for metric backfill complexity. if we enrich offline and need to reconcile historic metrics, we need a deterministic join key. what do you propose?

maria: good point. plan is to include a stable request_id and a short deterministic hash: `ingest_key = sha1(request_id + model_version + date)` emitted with both metrics and traces. offline job can join on `ingest_key` for any backfills. keys are fixed-length so they don't blow label cardinality.

sam: can you show a small example of the schema you'd like to emit?

maria: sure — rough example:

```
# emitted labels (low-cardinality):
model: \"rw-xl-1\"
variant: \"fp16\"
quant: \"q4_0\"
route: \"chat.complete\"
region: \"us-west-2\"
billing_tier: \"standard\"
ingest_key: \"b5f7a3...\"

# emitted metrics (per-request):
request_latency_ms: 48
token_count: 124
kv_cache_hits: 12
error: false
```

maria: offline job enriches with per-token-cost and model-inference-cost computed from kernel profile + h/w pricing, producing aggregated cost per ingest_key/day.

liam: how do we avoid double-counting when requests fan out to multiple model calls (reranking + summarize)?

nisha: idea: each sub-call gets its own ingest_key, and we emit a `parent_ingest_key` label to indicate the originating user request. billing attribution dedups by summing child costs but marking parent relationship so downstream accounting can either attribute to parent or bill per-call depending on product choice.

sam: nice. what about storage costs for storing request-level metrics for offline join? if we keep everything for 90 days we'll have a lot of rows.

maria: we'll TTL raw per-request rows at 7 days, but write daily rollups with full cost attribution retained for 365 days. rollups keyed by (date, model, route, billing_tier) plus optional parent_ingest_key for export.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: observability pipeline config v2 will be rolled out to staging on 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC.

alex: i like this approach. one more operational ask: add telemetry that counts how often offline-enrichment fails to join (missing ingest_key) so we can iterate on instrumentation.

maria: agree — will add a `join_failure_count` metric and a daily alert if >0.5% of requests fail join. i'll open a ticket with the schema and the rollout plan. thanks for the feedback! :thumbsup:
